brand.name: NomadMate
brand.timezone_note: Dates and times are shown in the phone's local time zone.

offline.kill_switch_note: Set enabled to false to make every installed copy unregister its service worker and clear its offline caches on the next online visit.

queue.note: Questions saved while offline (Normal Mode only; Emergency is never saved) and sent when the app is open and back online. Edit these numbers to tune it; no code change is needed.
